info.description:
The ORCID Public API lets anyone read the public data on ORCID records and search the registry.

A token is optional. Requests without one are accepted up to a daily quota per IP address; requests with a `/read-public` token, from the client credentials grant at `https://sandbox.orcid.org/oauth/token` (in production, `https://orcid.org/oauth/token`), are not held to that quota.

Send `Accept: application/json` on every request. Without it the API answers in XML. These pages show JSON only; every operation also answers in XML (`application/vnd.orcid+xml`).

Every operation and every error on these pages was exercised against a running Registry by the ORCID API contract tests, and the examples are the requests and responses those tests recorded.
info.title: ORCID Public API
